name: Horror
description: Artificial horrors beyond human comprehension. From biosynth-hybrid mechs and nanite-swarm gestalt-schools to phase-shifted tachyon phantoms. A horror may come in many forms, but those that are forced to face one in combat will always recognize it for what it is.

name: Abominable
effect: Scan doesn’t reveal any information about the Horror except that they are a Horror.

active_effects.name: Scan Immunity
active_effects.detail: Scan doesn’t reveal any information about you except that you are a Horror.

name: Mutations
effect: The Horror may choose 1 option from the Horror Mutations list plus an additional option per tier.

name: Quadruped
effect: The Horror gains Immunity to Prone and may move up to 4 spaces as a protocol.

active_effects.name: Quadruped
active_effects.detail: You gain Immunity to Prone and may move up to 4 spaces as a protocol.

name: Superfluous Extremities
effect: The Horror gains +1 Accuracy to Grapple and may perform Improvised Attack as a quick action.

active_effects.name: Superfluous Extremities
active_effects.detail: You gain +1 Accuracy to Grapple and may perform Improvised Attack as a quick action.

name: Artificial
effect: This trait can only be applied if the Horror is Biological. The Horror is no longer Biological and gains Heat Cap 6.

name: Terrifying
effect: Attacks against the Horror suffer +1 Difficulty if the attacker has line of sight to the target.

active_effects.name: Terrifying
active_effects.detail: Attacks against you suffer +1 Difficulty if the attacker has line of sight to the target.

name: Abhorrent Redundancies
effect: Whenever the Horror is reduced to 0 HP, they may roll 1d6. On a 5+, they return to 1 HP and gain {3/4/5} Overshield. After this trait triggers once, it only triggers again on a 6+.

active_effects.name: Abhorrent Redundancies
active_effects.detail: You may roll 1d6. On a 5+, you return to 1 HP and gain {3/4/5} Overshield. After this trait triggers once, it only triggers again on a 6+.

name: Assimilation Maw
effect: Additionally, if the Horror destroys another character with this weapon, allied or hostile, or hits a wreck, they regain {10/15/20} HP. Wrecks and allies are automatically hit by this weapon. Wrecks hit by this weapon are automatically destroyed.

on_hit.detail: If the target is at half or less HP after this attack is resolved, they must succeed on a Hull save or be reduced to 0 HP.

name: Phase-Shift Generator
effect: As a protocol, the Horror may become Intangible until the start of their next turn. Alternatively they may clear Intangible. The Horror may not become Intangible if they used this system on their last turn.

actions.name: Phase-Shift
actions.detail: You may become Intangible until the start of their next turn. Alternatively they may clear Intangible. You may not become Intangible if they used this system on their last turn.
